scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && gsutil -m rsync -r -x '^index\.html$' dist gs://twivvy.e-notix.com/ && gsutil -h 'Cache-Control:no-cache' cp dist/index.html gs://twivvy.e-notix.com/index.html && pnpm run deploy:app-pages
scripts.ios:generate: pnpm run ios:sync && xcodegen generate --spec ios/twivvy/project.yml
scripts.ios:build: pnpm run ios:generate && xcodebuild -project ios/twivvy/Twivvy.xcodeproj -scheme Twivvy -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/twivvy/build/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.hamsterlab:generate: pnpm run hamsterlab:sync && xcodegen generate --spec ios/hamsterlab/project.yml
scripts.hamsterlab:build: pnpm run hamsterlab:generate && xcodebuild -project ios/hamsterlab/HamsterLab.xcodeproj -scheme HamsterLab -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/hamsterlab/build/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.hamsterlab:test: pnpm run hamsterlab:generate && xcodebuild -project ios/hamsterlab/HamsterLab.xcodeproj -scheme HamsterLab -destination "${HAMSTERLAB_DESTINATION:-platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro Max,OS=18.6}" -derivedDataPath ios/hamsterlab/build/DerivedData -parallel-testing-enabled NO test
